task: ae.bdd: reduced ordered BDD manager (ITE, quantifiers, compose, satCount, cubes, checker) plus formula parser, verified by truth-table, subfunction-count, n-queens and adder oracles
reasoning_summary: Nodes are ints in a unique table so equal functions are equal ids, and everything derives from one memoised ITE. Tests compare against Java-evaluated random expression truth tables, an independent subfunction-counting oracle for node counts, n-queens counts 10/4/40/92 and adder equivalence with counterexamples. The first run failed only because my hand-derived node count (18) was wrong; the oracle and the 2^(n+1)-2 formula give 14.
